instruction:
You are given an incomplete base input file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cantilever_base.inp`.
Complete the full workflow from the command line:

1. Use Python or a shell script to generate three input files from the template:
   - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cantilever_100.inp` (load: 100 N)
   - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cantilever_200.inp` (load: 200 N)
   - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cantilever_300.inp` (load: 300 N)

2. Submit all jobs in batch (serial submission is acceptable).

3. Write a Python post-processing script `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\extract.py`:
   - Read the last frame of each ODB
   - Extract the global maximum Mises stress
   - Extract the maximum U2 displacement at the free end (`x≈100, y≈10`)
   - Print in this format: `job_name, max_mises, tip_u2`

4. Run the post-processing from the command line and save the log to `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\summary.txt`.
5. Ensure all generated files are under `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\`, and do not use the Abaqus/CAE GUI.

[Strict Output Format]
- Target file: `summary.txt`
- Required column order: `load, max_mises, tip_u2 (one case per line; loads 100/200/300)`
- Use ASCII comma `,` as delimiter.
- Numeric fields should be plain numbers only (no units, no extra prose).
- Keep exactly one data line for single-case outputs; for multi-case tasks, keep one case per line.
- You may add `#` comment lines, but do not add other non-data lines.
